title:
Epic for adding an expected sensor to an AssetClass.
Triggered by clicking 'Add Expected Sensor' button in AssetClassDetailExpectedSensorSidePanelForm.
Handles two scenarios:
Adding an existing sensor selected from the 'Existing' form.
Creating and adding a new custom sensor from the 'Custom' form.
Refreshes the tab panel and expected sensors grid after addition.
name: AssetClassAddCustomAndExistingExpectedSensorEpic
